title: Unfinished Business
overview: Summer is coming to an end, and the older kids at the club want to do the things they still have left to do.

title: Homecoming
overview: Iori and the gang head to his family home to grab his passport for the upcoming trip.

overview: Iori must navigate Shiori, the tourists, and the stalker on the loose to get his hands on his passport.

title: The Oceans of Palau
overview: The group eagerly arrives in Palau, where someone they know well is waiting for them.

title: TV Special
overview: A TV crew has arrived to film a special at Dolphin, and the gang gets roped into it!

title: Assist
overview: Kohei has figured out that Aina is into Iori and decides to help her in a way only he can.

title: Mother
overview: Tensions between Chisa and her mom come to a head as they clash over her life goals.

overview: Back home, Iori gets caught up in the scumbros' shenanigans again, and ends up having to set up a mixer.

title: Ordeals
overview: The boys have run into several issues over the summer, and they need the collective think tank to resolve them!
